# WyStack Agent Kit

> A portable agent-workflow kit that takes a coding agent through the whole software lifecycle — brainstorm → PRD → spec → breakdown → build → review → verify → ship — as one connected method. The rule holds at every stage: the agent carries the work, you carry the decisions. Runs identically on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Pi.

WyStack Agent Kit is a **plugin/skills bundle**, not a single skill. It ships 37 lifecycle skills and 10 universal role agents under one behavioral charter: the agent does the work and surfaces the calls that are yours — scope, trade-offs, what ships. Every skill leaves durable, auditable run records under `.wystack/` (typed project state, not chat history). It is supervised by default and autonomous when you choose (`orchestrate` runs parallel multi-ticket work; you still gate merges).

Where it sits in the ecosystem: discipline-primitive skill sets like [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) give an agent individual disciplines (TDD, domain modeling, grilling). WyStack Agent Kit is the **lifecycle layer over those primitives** — it wraps discipline into an end-to-end method with human-in-the-loop decision gates, auditable evidence, and optional parallel autonomy. The two compose: keep the primitives, add the lifecycle.

MIT licensed. It is a coding-agent plugin, not an MCP server.

## Install

- [Install (all harnesses)](https://github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit#install--30-seconds) — Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit` then `/plugin install wystack-agent-kit@wystack-agent-kit`
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wystack/agent-kit) — `@wystack/agent-kit`
- [First run / workspace bootstrap](https://github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit#first-run) — `wystack-agent-kit:setup-agent-kit`, once per repo

## Everyday loop (start here)

- `brainstorm` — turn a rough idea into a validated design before building
- `start-task` — plan, set up a worktree, and write a piece of work end to end
- `code-review` — multi-angle static review of a diff or branch before merge
- `finish-task` — gate the work, land the branch, clean up, update the tracker

## Full skill reference (by lifecycle stage)

- Planning — `brainstorm`, `prd`, `spec`, `breakdown`, `groom`, `estimation`, `reprioritize`, `next-task`, `new-task`
- Execution — `start-task`, `worktree`, `orchestrate`, `finish-task`, `cleanup`, `handoff`
- Review + verification — `code-review`, `full-review`, `critique`, `verify`, `perspective`, `retro`, `improve-codebase`
- Design — `establish`, `frontend`, `polish`
- Writing + distribution — `ux-writing`, `copywriting`, `discoverability`, `competitor-analysis`
- Workspace — `setup-agent-kit`, `workspace`, `identify-specialists`, `engineering-context`
- Role agents — `pm`, `principal`, `qa`, `devops`, `task-manager`, `wiki-librarian`, `designer`, `ux-writer`, `copywriter`, `marketing-specialist`

## How it works

- [Portability model](https://github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit#how-its-built) — one skill body runs on every harness; frontmatter carries the per-harness adapter
- [The constitution](https://github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit/blob/master/wystack-agent-kit/docs/constitution.md) — the agent carries work; the human owns decisions
- [Run records](https://github.com/youhaowei/wystack-agent-kit/blob/master/wystack-agent-kit/docs/run-record.md) — durable, queryable evidence under `.wystack/`
